Happy Feet Home Foundation Happy Feet Home (HFH) is a palliative care centre for children and young adults in India Silver Certified 2023 80G 12A CSR-1 Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Is this your profile? Edit now . Donate Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US FIELD VISIT Social --> Donate Cause Area Primary Sectors Child & Youth Development Health Secondary Sectors Health & Family Welfare Financials 2020 Total Income Rs. 9,059,853 Total Expenses Rs. 9,140,580 Non Program Expenses Rs. 2,096,615 Program Expenses Rs. 7,043,965 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. 2021 Total Income Rs. 14,019,221 Total Expenses Rs. 14,019,221 Non Program Expenses Rs. 2,803,844 Program Expenses Rs. 11,215,377 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. 2022 Total Income Rs. 8,257,405 Total Expenses Rs. 11,704,850 Non Program Expenses Rs. 1,560,646 Program Expenses Rs. 10,144,204 Tip: Click on any value above to exclude it. Geographies Served Programs Day care centre District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra The center offers day care services catering to a diverse age range, spanning from as young as 4 years old to as mature as 25 years old, all of whom are enrolled with the facility. Operating six days a week, children are encouraged to visit as frequently as desired. The center prioritizes holistic care, striving to meet the varied needs of its attendees. Within its walls, children discover a secure sanctuary. Hospital outreach program District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra To maintain ongoing and reliable access to medical assistance, guidance, and treatment, Happy Feet Home collaborates closely with Sion Hospital. It conducts programs with both Out-Patient (OPD) children from the HIV and Hematology departments and those admitted to the wards. These initiatives involve implementing Art-Based Therapy sessions for the children, offering guidance and mentorship to caregivers, and providing psycho-social support to registered families. Milestones & Track Record Happy Feet Home has been recognized as Mumbai Ke Asli Hero by Red FM in 2015, featured in Humans of Bombay in 2016, accredited as a Great Place to Work in 2024, and selected as a finalist for SVP India Fast Pitch 2024. --> --> Leadership Team Zarna Jain COO Saloni Sawnani Director Operations Mansi Shah CEO Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AABTH3187Q Registration Number E-30770 (Mumbai) CSR Form 1 CSR00002569 VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2018/0212027 --> 80G AABTH3187QF20214 12A AABTH3187QE20214 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 2014 Demographies Served Children --> Impact Happy Feet Home has been providing comprehensive palliative care services to children and young adults, including hospital outreach, community outreach, daycare centre, bereavement and end-of-life support, wish fulfillment, motivational activities, and a homecare program. Vision and Mission The vision is to create a world where every child who needs palliative care receives nurture, nourishment, and support to lead a happy and empowered life. Their mission is to change the perception of supporting children with life-limiting illnesses as more than just a 'lost cause' and to grow infrastructure and support for these children.
